items.title: 'Time for Ukraine to get new president,' says Trump after Zelensky condemns diesel deal
items.description: Ukraine's leader had said the deal with Russia to release diesel into the US would help Moscow fund the war.

items.title: Pope Leo to have surgery after lump found on lung
items.description: The 71-year-old pontiff said the nodule was identified "at a very early stage".

items.title: Homes and bridges swept away as fresh floods hit Nepal
items.description: Nepal is still trying to recover from catastrophic floods that hit less than two months ago, leaving thousands dead and missing.

items.title: Delhi sees more protests as freed 'cockroach' group's leaders vow to fight on
items.description: Hundreds of people who came out on the streets despite the police's restrictions were detained on Sunday.

items.title: US justice department investigates TV networks over Trump pool coverage
items.description: The White House had blocked access for CNN, MS Now and Politico, leading them to restrict pool coverage.

items.title: Children among 109 dead after boat capsizes off Djibouti, UN says
items.description: The boat was travelling from Djibouti to Yemen with 350 people on board, when it capsized near the port town of Obock on Thursday night.

items.title: Expedition hopes to find aviator Amelia Earhart's plane on remote island
items.description: The team en route to the suspected crash site aim finally to solve the mystery of her 1937 disappearance.

items.title: US murderer Christa Pike discharged from hospital 10 days after failed execution
items.description: Pike's lawyers say she is "grateful" to the medical team who cared for her after she survived two lethal injections last month.

items.title: Russian glide bomb attack on Zaporizhzhia kills at least 20 people
items.description: Volodymyr Zelensky says the attack, which left children dead, was Russia expressing its "thanks" for a US diesel deal.

items.title: Headmaster detained after BBC investigation into alleged sexual abuse of students
items.description: Former students launched their own investigation, spending years collecting evidence and testimonies from others who say they were abused by the headteacher.

items.title: Woman injures three people in third Poland school knife attack in a week
items.description: Polish police had already deployed to schools after a female caretaker was killed and several others injured in two earlier attacks in two days.

items.title: Nobel peace laureate says US sanctions on ICC 'unacceptable'
items.description: Navi Pillay says the Trump administrations' sweeping penalties on the international tribunal were "unheard of".

items.title: Rogue Anthropic AI agent gave police fake tip in unsolved murder case
items.description: Philadelphia police said the tip was "flagged as spam", but criticised the tech company for taking more than two months to detect and report the breach.

items.title: Drone strike by Sudan paramilitary kills 41 near Ethiopian border, rights group says
items.description: Eight children are said to be among those killed by the strike, which hit a gathering of displaced people.

items.title: US country music star Ella Langley cancels show due to 'security threat'
items.description: Police say they checked the concert venue in Tulsa, Oklahoma but "could not find any threat".

items.title: Flydubai attacker began a 'drift towards extremism and terrorism' in Australia, UAE says
items.description: The United Arab Emirates' attorney-general also alleges the co-pilot was trying to crash the plane into Tel Aviv's airport.

items.title: Three men found guilty of murdering Australian brothers and US friend in Mexico
items.description: Jake and Callum Robinson and their friend Carter Rhoad were on a surf trip when they were killed in an apparent botched robbery.

items.title: JD Vance casts doubt on firing squad execution and says he would not watch it
items.description: The planned execution of Nidal Hasan by firing squad would be the first military execution in more than 60 years.

items.title: Man named Hitler Mussolini elected mayor in Peru
items.description: The left-wing candidate won a narrow victory in a remote district in the Peruvian Andes, exit polls show.

items.title: Russian search engine Yandex struggles after Ukrainian strikes on data centres
items.description: Often dubbed "Russia's Google", the tech firm admits customers may experience disruption to digital services due to the attacks.
